blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 90 minutes. Do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.

blocks.heading: Boring names win
blocks.body:
`vase-parts.dita` will still make sense in six months. `Vase Parts FINAL(2).dita` will not.

When you rename, update the booklet. Then run completeness. If you skip that, the pointer still points at a ghost.

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: Completeness reports a missing file, or the new name has spaces, or you renamed the disk file and never updated the booklet.

Expected: New name is simple. Completeness clean. Old and new names written down.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Pick a page you added (or vase-parts.dita if you make a short new one).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: If Oxygen can rename and update references, use that. If not: rename on disk, then edit the pointer in the booklet to match.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Run completeness. It must be clean.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Write the old name and the new name in oxygen-bootcamp-work/week3/day-19-rename.txt.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Keep lowercase hyphens. No spaces. No FINAL(2).

blocks.summary: New name is simple. Completeness clean. Old and new names written down.

blocks.q: You renamed a file on disk and skipped the booklet. What breaks?
blocks.why: The booklet still has the old path.
Lowercase, hyphens, boring. Boring is good.
